_about: Organization names that identify no one: registration redaction placeholders and template text from WHOIS, RDAP and certificate records. Amass does not create an Organization from such a name, and never compares one for duplicates. A name matches when, ignoring case, surrounding punctuation and repeated spaces, it equals one of names or contains one of phrases. Phrases must not occur in a real company's name; use names for anything shorter or more general. Add values here, not in Go code.
